<summary>Which grades and programmes does KIMS offer?</summary>
KIMS offers Grades VI–VIII, O Level and A Level at its Gulberg II campus. Playgroup–Grade V is offered through Lahore School of Learning at a separate Gulberg III location.
Submit the admission form and required documents. KIMS reviews prior results and may require an admission test. If an offer is made, admission is final once the fee is paid.
<summary>Can I visit the campus before applying?</summary>
Contact KIMS to arrange a visit and confirm a suitable date and time.
<summary>Where can I check the latest fees and scholarships?</summary>
Read the published fee guide and scholarship page, then contact admissions to confirm the details for the current session.

<script>
    const menuButton=document.getElementById('menu-toggle');const menu=document.getElementById('nav-links');menuButton.addEventListener('click',()=>{const open=menuButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true';menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!open));menu.classList.toggle('open',!open);menuButton.textContent=open?'Menu':'Close'});menu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link=>link.addEventListener('click',()=>{menu.classList.remove('open');menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');menuButton.textContent='Menu'}));
    const nextStep={grade7:{title:'Build your middle school foundation',text:'Explore Grades VI–VIII at KIMS and plan the transition to Cambridge.',href:'https://kims.edu.pk/gr-vi-viii/',label:'Explore middle school ↗'},grade8:{title:'Explore the two-year O Level programme',text:'See programme details, subject options and current admission information.',href:'https://kims.edu.pk/o-level-programme/',label:'Explore O Level ↗'},olevel:{title:'Plan the next step after O Level',text:'Explore A Level options and ask KIMS about subject choices and guidance.',href:'https://kims.edu.pk/a-level/',label:'Explore A Level ↗'},alevel:{title:'Talk through your next step',text:'Contact KIMS for guidance on applications and university planning.',href:'https://kims.edu.pk/contact-us/',label:'Contact KIMS ↗'},primary:{title:'Explore early years and primary',text:'Playgroup–Grade V is offered by Lahore School of Learning at a separate Gulberg III campus.',href:'https://kims.edu.pk/playgroup-to-grade-v/',label:'Explore LSL ↗'}};
    document.getElementById('current-stage').addEventListener('change',event=>{const item=nextStep[event.target.value];const result=document.getElementById('path-result');if(!item){result.innerHTML='<small>Your suggested next step</small><h3>Start with your student’s current stage.</h3><p>See which programme to explore next and where to ask questions.</p><a class="text-link" href="https://kims.edu.pk/admissions/">View admissions ↗</a>';return}result.innerHTML=`<small>Your suggested next step</small><h3>${item.title}</h3><p>${item.text}</p><a class="text-link" href="${item.href}">${item.label}</a>`});
  </script>
